companies.name: Stafford Bros & Draeger
companies.distributes: Imported and local specialty foods for international brand owners: biscuits (Walkers Scottish Shortbread), jams and marmalades (Mackays), crispbreads (Ryvita), teas and malt drinks (Twinings, Ovaltine), Mexican snacks and sauces (Banditos), plus Simply Delish, Thistlewood, Tipiak and Mazetti.
companies.channels_supplied: All major supermarket chains, cash and carry outlets, wholesalers, independent retailers and food service across Southern Africa.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Simply Delish (sugar-free jelly and dessert mixes); not a direct competitor in Diablo's snack categories.
companies.fit_rationale: A full-service distributor that has built UK and European branded packaged food in South African supermarkets for decades, with category manager relationships at the major chains, which suits a British brand like Diablo. It already sells biscuits and jams from other brands and a sugar-free dessert line. Scale: national coverage across Southern Africa with Regional and Field Sales Managers calling on all major supermarket chains, cash and carries and wholesalers; outlet and fleet numbers are not shown on its website. Storage: products warehoused in Johannesburg and delivered nationwide through a warehousing and logistics partner.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1921 and incorporated in 1951, distributing international brands such as Twinings, Ovaltine and Walkers shortbread in Southern Africa.
Own sales and merchandising teams, led by Regional and Field Sales Managers, cover all major supermarket chains, cash and carries and wholesalers.
